candidates.sentence: I swore an oath to protect and defend the American people and an unsecure border undermines that promise and their safety.
It has been more than a year since the Senate failed to keep its promise and repeal Obamacare.
While this disappointment still weighs on me, I will continue to fight for legislation to repeal and replace Obamacare with policies that restore health care freedom in America.
Earlier this year, President Trump signed the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act into law, fulfilling his promise of tax reform to the American people.

I support efforts to strengthen the solvency of both Social Security and Medicare so that it is protected for future generations, but any such plan must make sure that the promise is kept and that no one in or nearing retirement has any changes to their plans.
The Democrats’ new gun control bill, H.R. 8, is a reckless attack on legal firearm owners that will do NOTHING to address the current gun violence in America.
He believes our Founders established the Second Amendment to safeguard American liberty and will do everything in his power to ensure that the Democrats don’t infringe on that right.

That’s why I have led the effort in Congress to ensure refugees from terrorist hotbeds are fully vetted, deport criminal aliens, and cut off taxpayer funding for “sanctuary cities” that threaten our nation’s immigration laws.
To remain a sovereign nation, we must secure and control our borders.
I have also consistently voted to cut off taxpayer funding for Planned Parenthood – the largest abortion provider in the nation.
As a senior myself, I am committed to ensuring that the federal government fulfills it promises to those who have built their retirement around Social Security and Medicare.
